$comment: Single source of the Rule 13 journey-marker patterns (CLAUDE.md). `pattern` flags journey PROSE (comments, test titles, doc text; applied case-insensitively). `namePattern` flags journey tokens in DURABLE NAMES (exported identifiers, file/directory names, Nx target names); it is applied to the kebab-normalized form of a name — camelCase boundaries become '-', every non-alphanumeric run becomes '-', then lowercased — so word boundaries hold (`handleAuthV2` normalizes to `handle-auth-v2` and matches; `renewal`, `stepId`, `newValue`, `uuidv4` never match). `new`/`old`/`temp` are flagged only as the trailing segment (a `utils-new` sibling), because leading forms legitimately describe end-state behavior (`NewWorkflowModal` creates a new workflow, `tempDir` holds genuinely temporary files). Bare milestone codes (`m0`, `m1`, …) are journey markers — they say WHEN a thing was built, not what it IS — so `m\d+` is flagged; bare gate codes (`g0`…`g4`) are deliberately NOT flagged: a gate is end-state vocabulary (`conformance.mjs` reads the `gate:G#` tag, the roadmap's gate table is permanent), so `conformance-g0` is a valid durable name. Do not 'balance' the asymmetry into a generic `[a-z]\d+` — that would outlaw the gate names this workspace depends on. Consumers: shared/tools/eslint-local-rules/no-journey-markers.mjs, shared/tools/eslint-local-rules/no-journey-marker-names.mjs, shared/tools/dev-cli/src/check-journey-markers.mjs.
